methods_quotes.q: Chi-square tests were performed to examine differences in past-year quit attempts between the years 2011 and 2017 (p<0.05).
Logistic regression was used to assess overall changes in prevalence during 2011–2017, controlling for sex, age group, and race/ethnicity (p<0.05).
Quartiles were mapped and assessed by U.S. Census region.
All analyses were conducted using SAS-callable SUDAAN software (version 11.0.3; RTI International) to account for the complex survey sampling design.
